decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 100-AL-(02)R.01, 101-AL(02)R.01, 102-AL(02)R.01, 103-AL(02)R.01, 110-AL(02)R.01, 111-AL(02)R.01, 120-AL(02)R.01, 121-AL(02)R.01, 122-AL(02)R.01, Received 30 August 2011, 140-AL(04)R.01, 141-AL(04)R.01, 142-AL(04)R.01, 143-AL(04)R.01, 143-AL(4)-2R.01, 150-AL(05)R.01, 151-AL(05)R.01, 160-AL(06)R.01, 161-AL(06)R.01, 162-AL(06)R.01, 163-AL(06)R.01, Received 26 October 2011  and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls or roof of the original dwelling or the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces (brick, railings, window framing, tiles) of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a two storey front extension, three dormers to the front roof slope, installation of French doors and outdoor terrace to the front of the house.
